visual_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 2 more consistently places the array, indices, low/mid/high markers, highlighted search space, target index 7, and O(log n) halving equations correctly, while Lesson 1 has sparser visuals with ambiguous/inconsistent pointer states during the trace and a partially incomplete/garbled introductory array/title.

interactivity.rationale: Lesson 2 has a functional wired quiz gate with a real question, plausible options, and a marked correct answer after act_found, while Lesson 1 has no available gate specs or plan and therefore no functioning checkpoints.

narration_quality.rationale: Lesson 2 has clear, well-paced narration with spoken math rendered naturally, while Lesson 1 has no available transcript and therefore provides no assessable narration quality.

sync.rationale: Lesson 2 provides timed visual cues that are mostly aligned with the narrated references, while Lesson 1 has no transcript or cue data at all and therefore cannot demonstrate synchronization.

concept_accuracy.rationale: Lesson 2 accurately traces the binary search, explains the sorted-array halving logic and logarithmic derivation clearly, while Lesson 1 has no available transcript or plan to demonstrate any correct or pedagogically useful content.

polish.rationale: Lesson 2 has a much more polished, legible, consistently styled modern layout, while Lesson 1 is sparse, often off-center, uses tiny/dim text and cramped diagrams with occasional awkward overlaps, despite Lesson 2 having minor label overlap and a small raw inline formula artifact.

aggregator.explanation: All six dimension agents prefer Lesson 2, with high confidence across the board. Lesson 2 is judged more visually accurate, interactive, well-narrated, synchronized, conceptually correct, and polished. The strongest differences are that Lesson 2 includes a functional quiz gate, clear narration, timed visual cues, and an accurate binary search explanation, while Lesson 1 lacks transcript/plan evidence for several dimensions and has sparse or inconsistent visuals. Minor polish issues in Lesson 2 do not outweigh its consistent advantages.
